matched.actualTitle: Boolean-based SQL Injection in Product Search Endpoint / SQL Injection in Search API / Boolean-based SQL Injection in Search Parameter
matched.matchReason: Multiple actual findings identify the same core SQL injection vulnerability in the search endpoint that was expected. While the expected finding specified time-based blind injection, the actual findings discovered boolean-based SQL injection in the same location (/api/search endpoint with 'q' parameter). Both represent the same fundamental vulnerability - unsanitized user input being interpolated into SQL queries - allowing database access and data extraction. The impact and exploitation method are equivalent, just using boolean logic instead of time delays.

extra.title: Rate Limiting Bypass - No Request Throttling
